analysis_md:
对 $x$ 求偏导，$x-a\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=\varphi'(-b\frac{\partial z}{\partial x})$，则 $\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=\frac{1}{a-b\varphi'}$，

对 $y$ 求偏导，$-a\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=\varphi'(1-b\frac{\partial z}{\partial x})$，则 $\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=\frac{\varphi'}{b\varphi'-a}$，因此，
